newsitem.title: USA: US Prudential pays $384,200 in Virginia settlement.
newsitem.headline: US Prudential pays $384,200 in Virginia settlement.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America said on Friday it will pay $384,200 to settle a lawsuit brought by the Commonwealth of Virginia, and it acknowledged that some policyholders may have been misled by Prudential agents.

The settlement follows the terms of a multistate remediation program and class-action settlement currently pending before a U.S. district court in New Jersey, under which Prudential would pay out at least $410 million to life-insurance policyholders throughout the nation.
The company estimates that as many as 175,000 Virginians bought individual policies between 1982 and 1995.
